profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience who excels at building web applications and leading teams to tackle complex projects. At Anduril, I led a team of five engineers in the development of a real-time streaming application using WebSockets, React and RxJS. Previously, I have scaled a frontend team from one to 12 engineers, and I built the micro-frontend architecture at DevRev. Outside of work, I enjoy traveling and exploring new ways to apply my engineering background, from brewing beer to game design using C++ and Unreal Engine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led cross-functional Guest Checkout project to increase the conversion rate of our Next.js Checkout app
• Built a Server-Sent Events GraphQL proof of concept to give users real-time updates during checkout
• Bridged the gap between backend and frontend by learning Go and contributing to backend microservices
• Improved Next.js app performance using code splitting, tree shaking, caching, and lazy loading
• Contributed bug fixes and new features to our shared component library using React and TypeScript
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Software Design · Front-End Development · Mentoring · Team Leadership · JavaScript · Go (Programming Language) · Apollo GraphQL · Next.js · Apollo · GraphQL

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Scaled the UI team from 1 to 12 engineers as a team lead and mentor at a rapid-growth startup
• Built a real-time messaging Progressive Web App (PWA) using a Micro Frontend Architecture and Next.js + WebSockets + Redis + DynamoDB
• Implemented real-time notifications to notify users of @mentions and #mentions of objects in rich-text messages
• Built a normalized data layer using React Query to share data fetching logic and reduce excessive API calls by up to 90%
• Established processes for designing, code reviewing, and testing React applications and components
• Documented team processes and best practices for using React, TypeScript, and Cypress
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · HTML5 · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · Front-End Development · Mentoring · Attention to Detail · Node.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · System Architecture · Team Leadership · JavaScript · Webpack · Apollo GraphQL · Next.js · Project Management

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of four engineers to build a cross-platform, in-app tipping experience in three months that reduced the fulfillment cost per shipment and improved delivery driver retention rate
• Designed and built a package label printing service using Ruby on Rails that improved the SF pharmacy’s fulfillment automation rate by 20%
• Led a root cause analysis on our shared React + TypeScript table component that improved re-render time by 99%
• Won 1st place in a hackathon by building a Chrome extension for bug reporting that reduced the average time to resolution for on-call bugs by up to 50%
• Established commit standards for the engineering organization and automated release processes
• Hosted several tech talks for the engineering org to learn and share best practices
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Root Cause Analysis · TypeScript · Ruby · SQL · Team Leadership · JavaScript · React Native · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · Full-Stack Development · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the architecture design and implementation of a greenfield application migration from Angular 1 to React 16
• Led the frontend framework selection for our unified login application
• Mentored team members and collaborated with other teams to establish React best practices
• Built native Web Components for our shared component library with Svelte
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · React.js · SASS · TypeScript · AngularJS · Front-End Development · Migration Projects · JavaScript · Web Components · Webpack · Svelte

positions.title: UI Engineer III, Team Lead
positions.description:
• Led a team of three UI engineers in the design and development of a React dashboard app that enabled visualization of customers' data center metrics
• Mentored interns and new hires through code reviews and regular one on one meetings

positions.title: UI Engineer II
positions.description:
• Wrote Python APIs to enable filtered CSV data downloads from an Elasticsearch backend
• Implemented “progressive transpilation” to support JavaScript ES6 features while maintaining IE10 compatibility

positions.title: UI Engineer I
positions.description:
• Implemented bug fixes and new features for our customer-facing dashboard app using Backbone JS
• Organized engineering discussions about React optimizations and new JavaScript ES6 language features
• Collaborated with designers and engineers to win the Nutanix 4.0 Hackathon competition

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Transformed static mockups into fully responsive, accessible UIs using HTML5, CSS3, and React
• Reduced development time by up to two weeks by creating a lightweight CSS framework for designers to prototype in-browser
• Reduced deployment time by 90% using Gulp.js build scripts, Capistrano, and Docker containers
• Collaborated with designers to establish personas, user flows, and wireframes
• Built intricate 60 fps animations using CSS and GSAP
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · SASS · HTML5 · User Interface Prototyping · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Animation · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Web Developer (part-time)
positions.description:
• Designed and built the University’s RecSports department website averaging 200,000+ unique views per month
• Built data collection forms using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL
• Created responsive themes and custom plugins for ExpressionEngine and WordPress websites
• Wrote training manuals and hosted training sessions for other university web developers to learn how to manage websites
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · HTML

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I developed preventive maintenance instructions and schedules using SAP to maintain engine assembly equipment, which resulted in minimizing unplanned downtime and saving thousands of dollars in potential machine repairs.

I also improved the process for maintaining solvent concentrations in a chemical bath clean line by coding a program in Visual Basic for management to visually assess the pH status, and initiated documentation of solvent concentration data for future SPC analysis

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Worked with Technology team and Art & Layout team to rebuild the new website from the ground up
- Coordinated and controlled media display during the 26.2 hour event
- Successfully added new features to the website that were requested during the event with tight deadlines
- Total money raised for the 2015 event was over $2,000,000 and all proceeds went to the Children's Miracle Network to benefit UF Shands Children's Hospital
I served several shifts over the 26.2 hour event during which I cleaned up and acted as security for the event.
